releases.notes:
## Minecraft 1.21.1

Released support for Minecraft 1.21.1. This is the same mod, ported from Minecraft 1.20.1, now
built against Fabric API, Origins, and Apoli for the newer game version, including a full port of
every mixin and every data pack power to the new mappings and schema.

Requirements, all for 1.21.1 Fabric, Java 21 or newer needed to launch at all.

1. Fabric API `0.116.15+1.21.1` or newer
2. Origins `1.13.0-pre.3+mc.1.21.1` or newer, currently the newest build available for this
   Minecraft version, no stable non prerelease Origins build exists for 1.21.1 yet
3. Pehkui `3.8.3+1.14.4-1.21` or newer, the same jar already used on the 1.20.1 release

See README.md on the `mc1.21.1-port` branch for the full details.

## Arachne

Walking through cobwebs no longer slows you down. The power meant to do this had silently done
nothing since the mod's very first commit, confirmed by decompiling Apoli directly, now fixed
with the real, functional power.

Sure Footed is now unconditional. She never takes fall damage at all, matching how the fall
damage reduction power actually behaved in practice (it never really applied its intended
partial reduction above 10 blocks).

A normal punch (webbing a target in a temporary cobweb without sneaking) now applies Immobilized
for 2 seconds, down from 3. Fixed the same power silently doing nothing on this version too, a
different cause than the cobweb slowdown fix above, its power type had been deprecated and left
unwired by Apoli for this Minecraft version.

An Immobilized target can no longer hit you if you are standing behind it, or from more than
point blank range. Previously it could still land hits regardless of facing or distance.

## Medusa

Removed Stone Gaze, the passive, always on petrify pulse. Stone Gaze Burst, the secondary key
ability, is unchanged.

The Serpent Aegis is now genuinely Medusa only. Before, any origin able to use a shield at all
could raise and block with it, despite the tooltip already claiming otherwise.

The Serpent Aegis now actually slows its wielder while equipped, matching Slowness I. This
needed a real attribute modifier rather than the status effect itself, since Medusa's own Stone
Cursed immunity blocked the effect version entirely.

## Mermaid

Removed "every sea creature is friendly." Sea creatures behave like vanilla again.

releases.notes:
## Origins Minus is no longer required

Rappel was the only thing this mod ever used from Origins Minus. It's now fully native content
ported in place with the same climb mechanic and speed, minus a few unused flourishes (a resource
bar that was never actually drained, an unrelated mining speed bonus, and a redundant projectile
visual effect). Its in game description now also mentions the doubletap jump step needed to
start climbing, which the old description had omitted.

**You no longer need to install Origins Minus**  just Fabric API, Origins, and Pehkui.

The original mechanic's design, from Origins Minus's own Weaver origin, is credited in
CREDITS.md  nothing of theirs ships in this mod anymore, but the credit stays.

Bumped to 2.0.0 since this changes the mod's install requirements, not just its content.

releases.notes:
## Mermaid: bare-hand coral mining fixed

Mining a living coral block by hand (or any tool that fails the correct-tool check) now drops
the live block directly. Vanilla only ever rolls coral's loot table with a correct tool, so
there was never a drop for the old swap-based approach to catch when mining by hand , the one
legitimate way to reach the coral block her own Living Coral Trident recipe needs. Pickaxe
mining is unchanged.

## Full immobilization

A target affected by Arachne's web bite, the Silk Net Shooter, Medusa's petrify gaze, Medusa's
petrifying bite, or the Petrifying Trident is now completely locked in place, no turning to
face or attack while trapped, not just slowed. Medusa's Petrify movement penalty was also raised
from -90% to a true -100% full stop.

## Arachne: Leap replaces Scuttle

The old Speed IV burst is gone. In its place: a short forward-and-upward pounce, about 5 blocks,
on the same secondary key, 3 second cooldown. Rappel also climbs twice as fast.

## Dedicated creative tab

Every item this mod adds now lives in its own creative-inventory tab (icon: Widowfang), instead
of being scattered across vanilla Combat/Food & Drinks/Ingredients tabs.

releases.notes:
## Harpy: flight stamina cost actually works now

The stamina cost added in 1.1.1 never had any real effect: it wrote directly to saturation, but
vanilla only ever drops the visible hunger bar once saturation is already at 0, which is where it
sits most of the time anyway, making the whole feature silently do nothing.

Reworked to charge hunger while she's actively gaining speed in flight, routed through vanilla's
real exhaustion pipeline. Steady gliding/coasting still costs nothing, no matter how long it lasts.

Small hotfix, no other changes.
